findings.finding: Clockwise on the knob turns the volume DOWN (Ultra and Plus). EC11E1834403 (no detents, 18 pulses): Alps CW has A leading; with pull-ups (OFF=1) CW from rest is 11->01->00->10->11 (A,B); hifi_exp.c QUAD counts that -1 per edge, so one CW turn = -18 steps = -36 volume. test_core.c assumes B leads ('11 -> 10 -> 00 -> 01 -> 11'). Footprint pad A = Alps terminal A (fig. 5 turned 180, not mirrored), A -> ENC_A -> U17 P12 = enc_a.
findings.evidence: Alps EC11 catalogue (LCSC C361165) p.1 table (EC11E1834403: detents none, 18 pulses), p.282 output waveform (CW, A leads), p.278 fig.5 hole layout; board pads SW4 A(91.595,40.55) B(86.515,40.55) D(91.595,55.05) E(86.515,55.05) rot 180; test docs/review-5/sims/uf/enc_rev.c FAILS: 'clockwise (A leads) counts -18 per turn'.
findings.reference_design: Alps/Bourns convention: CW seen from the shaft end, A leads B; decoders count that +.
findings.fix: board_core.c controls(): .enc_a = EXP_ENC_B, .enc_b = EXP_ENC_A (or negate steps); fix test_core.c cw/ccw tables; bench: one CW turn must raise volume by 36.
findings.margin: firmware-only; 100 % of turns go the wrong way

findings.finding: User-touched switches have no clamp: TS-1187A-B-A-B has a brass keystake and stainless cover; BTN1-3 go straight to U1 (UMW TCA9535, no ESD rating; TI 2 kV HBM) with only a 10k pull-up. Path from panel face to switch metal ~5.8 mm of seams (0.3 mm cap gap through 2.4 mm wall, past 8.5 mm flange, 0.3 mm air). Knob strike lands on EC11 frame = GND; the board-to-board return over 5 FFC GND conductors (~15 nH) moves grounds ~55 V for ~1 ns if 10 % of 30 A crosses (screen estimate).
findings.evidence: XKB TS-1187A-X-X-X drawing (Keystake B: Brass, Cover Sus); enclosure/core_box.py ultra_buttons (WALL 2.4, BTN_CAP 6.0 in 6.6, flange 8.5); IEC 61000-4-2 8 kV air.
findings.reference_design: TI SLVA680: clamp at the touch point, short to GND.
findings.fix: PESD5V0S2BT (C49338) on BTN1/BTN2 and BTN3/ENC_SW at the switches with own GND via (~$0.05 each), or 1 nF X7R per BTN net; bring-up 8 kV air gun on caps and knob.
findings.margin: unknown: depends on which terminal the dome sits on; ~5.8 mm seam vs ~8 mm 8 kV reach

findings.finding: Firmware runs the ST7789 SPI at 20 MHz (50 ns) against its 66 ns minimum serial write cycle (15.15 MHz) and requirements.md / README's 'SPI at 15 MHz or less'. R402/R403 (33R) sit 44-49 mm from U7's pins, not at the source as the README asked. SI is fine: as-built bench passes.
findings.evidence: sdkconfig.defaults l.207 speed=20000000; core R402 (96.0,199.8) vs U7 pin 8 (139.7,191.7); docs/review-5/sims/uf/tb_sck_asbuilt.cir: high min 3.25 V (VIH 2.31), low max 0.05 V (VIL 0.99), +3.77/-0.47 V.
findings.reference_design: ST7789V datasheet tSCYCW 66 ns; TFT_eSPI commonly runs ST7789 at 27-80 MHz.
findings.fix: DISPLAY_CONFIG speed=16000000 (in spec, ~25 % slower redraw), or keep 20 MHz and verify a full-screen redraw at bring-up.
findings.margin: 32 % over the timing spec; SI margin 0.94 V

findings.finding: Backlight is on/off only: LCD_BL is a TCA9539 bit, not a PWM GPIO, while requirements B3 'PWM-dimmable from the core' and product.md l.462 'backlight PWM' say dimmable. It runs at a fixed 39-64 mA and firmware keeps it at full brightness for all of playback.
findings.evidence: core blocks_mcu.py U17 P06 = LCD_BL; board_core.c exp_set(EXP_LCD_BL, audio_active || touched<60 s); backlight (5.25-2.7)/40 = 64 mA, (4.75-3.2)/40 = 39 mA.
findings.fix: Accept and correct the docs, or firmware software PWM through U17 at ~200 Hz (400 writes/s x ~75 us = 3 % of the 400 kHz bus).
findings.margin: spec drift; no hardware change possible without a free GPIO

findings.finding: The FFC cable isn't a concrete part: docs/bom-estimate.csv says '20P 0.5 mm 100 mm' with no type, while the READMEs say type B, 30-50 mm. A common type-A cable with one end flipped maps pin N -> 21-N: rails stay safe, but U17 P06 (push-pull) drives into front GND (pin 11) and ESP32 GPIO32 (SCK) into ENC_A, which is GND while the knob rests with A closed.
findings.evidence: docs/review-5/sims/uf/ffc_orient.py reversed-cable listing; TCA9539 50 mA abs per pin; ESP32 GPIO short ~40-80 mA.
findings.fix: Name a buyable 20P 0.5 mm 50 mm type-B (reverse) FFC in the order list; correct bom-estimate to 30-50 mm (route needs ~25-30 mm).

findings.finding: Ordered HASL (gbrjob Finish HASL) with 0.3 mm pads at 0.5 mm pitch (J1, J2) and 0.4 mm TSSOP pads; round 1's DFM-8 'order ENIG' disposition names Lite and core only.
findings.reference_design: JLC: ENIG preferred for fine pitch.
findings.fix: Order ENIG for ultra-front too (~$2-5 a 5-board order).

findings.finding: IR supply RC filter is 9.6 mm of IR_VCC track from U2 pin 4 (Everlight: 'as close as possible'); little switching noise on this board. Bench range test while the panel redraws.
LCD VCI/IOVCC operating max is 3.3 V; core +3V3 is 3.33 V nominal, up to ~3.40 V; abs max 4.6 V (1.2 V margin).
EC11 footprint centres its rows at 7.25 mm against Alps 7.5/7.0, so the shaft is 0.25 mm off the footprint origin; 1.2 mm holes take it (round 1 DFM-14).
U1 is the UMW TCA9535 clone; its registers, address and 5.5 V-tolerant inputs match TI's; it gives no ESD figure.
EXP_INT on GPIO39: ESP32 errata 3.11 glitch when the ADC powers up, so ISENSE sampling causes spurious notifications at ~0.4 ms of I2C each. Harmless.
exp_init turns the backlight on before display init: a white/garbage flash at boot. Turn LCD_BL on after display_init.
The 'rotate' orientation of the 320x240 panel with its tail to J2 can only be checked on the bench.
Rails mirror 1/20, 2/19, 3/18: a reversed cable never shorts a rail (ffc_orient.py).
The EasyEDA model's silk dot sits nearest pad 4; the pinout against Everlight's 3D view is right (1/2 GND left, 3 OUT bottom-right, 4 VCC top-right, counter-clockwise).
